facts.fact: The Central Bank of Eswatini's Practice Note No.1/2019/NPSS for mobile money service providers, in force from 5 March 2019, sets consumer-protection rules on fee disclosure, written customer contracts and complaints handling.
facts.system: Practice Note for Mobile Money Service Providers

facts.fact: The Practice Note requires mobile money providers to run a complaints desk and free hotline, and lets an unsatisfied complainant escalate an unresolved decision to the Central Bank of Eswatini.
facts.system: Practice Note for Mobile Money Service Providers

systems.system: Practice Note for Mobile Money Service Providers

SWZ.note: No enforcement action or complaint figures are stated.
